content.title: Community Garden Rescue Quest
content.themeSummary: A neighborhood stewardship adventure for reviving an overgrown community garden with volunteers, budgets, planting plans, and maintenance rituals.
content.goalSummary: Turn an abandoned garden plot into a safe, planted, and sustainably maintained community space before the next growing season.
safetyNotes: Use gloves and safe lifting practices during cleanup.
Confirm local rules before applying soil amendments, installing structures, or hosting public events.

acts.title: Scout the Overgrown Realm
acts.summary: Assess the site, recruit helpers, and create a safe cleanup plan with local approval.

mainQuests.title: Complete the Garden Site Audit
mainQuests.description: Map beds, water access, hazards, sunlight, soil concerns, tool needs, and accessibility barriers.
mainQuests.doneCondition: The audit includes photos, a bed map, hazard list, water notes, and the top five restoration constraints.
mainQuests.rewardIntent: Reward careful discovery before mobilizing volunteers.

steps.description: Map the garden details and constraints for complete the garden site audit.
Gather the people, tools, or notes needed for complete the garden site audit.
Confirm the documented outcome for complete the garden site audit before moving on.

mainQuests.title: Assemble the Volunteer Roster
mainQuests.description: Recruit neighbors, clarify roles, gather availability, and assign cleanup leads, supply leads, and communications support.
mainQuests.doneCondition: At least eight volunteers are listed with roles, contact details, and availability for the first workday.
mainQuests.rewardIntent: Reward building the team needed for a larger restoration effort.

steps.description: Map the garden details and constraints for assemble the volunteer roster.
Gather the people, tools, or notes needed for assemble the volunteer roster.
Confirm the documented outcome for assemble the volunteer roster before moving on.

sideQuests.title: Secure Permission and Donations
sideQuests.description: Confirm garden permissions, request donated compost or mulch, and identify any spending approvals needed.
sideQuests.doneCondition: Permission status, donation leads, and budget constraints are documented before purchases happen.
sideQuests.rewardIntent: Reward reducing logistical and financial risk.

steps.description: Map the garden details and constraints for secure permission and donations.
Gather the people, tools, or notes needed for secure permission and donations.
Confirm the documented outcome for secure permission and donations before moving on.

bossFights.title: Lead the Safe Cleanup Day
bossFights.description: Coordinate volunteers to clear debris, weed beds, mark hazards, sort salvageable materials, and leave the site safer than it started.
bossFights.doneCondition: The cleanup day is completed with hazards removed or marked, debris disposed of, and next restoration tasks documented.
bossFights.rewardIntent: Reward converting plans and volunteers into visible site progress.

acts.title: Plant the Living Stronghold
acts.summary: Design the planting plan, build maintenance systems, and launch a sustainable community rhythm.

mainQuests.title: Design the Planting Plan
mainQuests.description: Choose seasonal crops or native plants, assign beds, plan companion planting, and match plants to sunlight and watering constraints.
mainQuests.doneCondition: A bed-by-bed planting plan lists plants, quantities, timing, water needs, and responsible caretakers.
mainQuests.rewardIntent: Reward translating the restored space into a realistic growing plan.

steps.description: Map the garden details and constraints for design the planting plan.
Gather the people, tools, or notes needed for design the planting plan.
Confirm the documented outcome for design the planting plan before moving on.

mainQuests.title: Create the Maintenance Rotation
mainQuests.description: Set watering, weeding, harvesting, compost, and communication responsibilities for the first eight weeks.
mainQuests.doneCondition: The shared rotation covers eight weeks and each week has named caretakers and escalation contacts.
mainQuests.rewardIntent: Reward sustainability after the initial excitement fades.

steps.description: Map the garden details and constraints for create the maintenance rotation.
Gather the people, tools, or notes needed for create the maintenance rotation.
Confirm the documented outcome for create the maintenance rotation before moving on.

sideQuests.title: Install Community Signage
sideQuests.description: Create welcoming signs with garden rules, contact info, harvest expectations, and upcoming volunteer dates.
sideQuests.doneCondition: Weather-safe signs are installed at the garden entrance and near shared beds.
sideQuests.rewardIntent: Reward clear communication for neighbors and visitors.

steps.description: Map the garden details and constraints for install community signage.
Gather the people, tools, or notes needed for install community signage.
Confirm the documented outcome for install community signage before moving on.

bossFights.title: Complete the First Planting Weekend
bossFights.description: Coordinate supplies, volunteers, bed prep, planting, watering, signage, and the first maintenance handoff.
bossFights.doneCondition: Priority beds are planted, watered, labeled, and assigned to the maintenance rotation.
bossFights.rewardIntent: Reward the transition from rescue project to living community garden.

skills.name: Site Assessment
skills.description: Evaluate garden conditions, hazards, sunlight, water, accessibility, and restoration constraints.

skills.name: Volunteer Coordination
skills.description: Recruit, schedule, brief, and support a neighborhood volunteer team.

skills.name: Logistics and Budgeting
skills.description: Manage permissions, donations, supply needs, budget limits, and workday sequencing.

skills.name: Planting Design
skills.description: Match plants, beds, seasons, sunlight, watering needs, and caretaker capacity.

skills.name: Maintenance Systems
skills.description: Create shared rotations, rules, communication habits, and handoffs that keep the garden healthy.

inventoryItems.name: Site Audit Map
inventoryItems.purpose: Photos, bed map, water notes, hazards, and constraints for restoration planning.

inventoryItems.name: Volunteer Roster
inventoryItems.purpose: A contact and role list for cleanup, planting, supplies, and communications.

inventoryItems.name: Permission and Donation Log
inventoryItems.purpose: Permission status, donation leads, budget limits, and purchase approvals.

inventoryItems.name: Cleanup Safety Kit
inventoryItems.purpose: Gloves, bags, first aid basics, hazard markers, and safety reminders for workdays.

inventoryItems.name: Planting Plan
inventoryItems.purpose: Bed assignments, plant quantities, timing, water needs, and caretaker names.

inventoryItems.name: Maintenance Calendar
inventoryItems.purpose: An eight-week schedule for watering, weeding, harvesting, compost, and escalation contacts.

inventoryItems.name: Community Signage Pack
inventoryItems.purpose: Weather-safe signs for rules, contact information, harvest expectations, and volunteer dates.

achievements.name: Garden Cleared Safely
achievements.description: The abandoned plot is safer, mapped, and ready for planting preparation.
achievements.unlockCondition: Unlocked when cleanup day is completed and next tasks are documented.

achievements.name: First Planting Weekend Complete
achievements.description: Priority beds are planted and assigned to caretakers.
achievements.unlockCondition: Unlocked when the planting weekend ends with watered, labeled, and assigned beds.

focusedNextActions.title: Walk the plot with a camera
focusedNextActions.description: Capture photos and notes for hazards, water access, sunlight, and bed conditions.

focusedNextActions.title: Recruit three role leads
focusedNextActions.description: Ask one neighbor each to lead cleanup, supplies, and communications.
